tei:div.tei:p: rtsom pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/

byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i rtsom pa po dpal phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po ni khams rme shod sde dge dpe war du yab phan thogs a dar dang*/ yum khu 'dzoms a lce gnyis kyis sras su rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags stag spyi lo ( 1110) la 'khrungs/ dgung lo dgu la mkhan po tshul khrims 'bar gyi drung dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan rdo rje rgyal por gsol/ dgung lo bco brgyad la dbus su byon/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis la gsang phur dge bshes rgya dmar ba las/ phar tshad dang dbu ma rigs tshogs sogs gsan bsam mdzad de gzhung thams cad la mkhas par gyur/ dgung lo nyer lnga la zul phur bya 'dul 'dzin gyis mkhan po dang*/ stod lung rgya dmar pas las slob/ ar gyis gsang ston mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan slob de dag gi drung du 'dul ba'i sde snod rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son par mdzad de mkhas pa'i grags pas nor 'dzin gyi khyon kun tu khyab/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya yul ba dang*/ dpal rga lo/ ras chung pa'i slob ma bur sgom pa/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po sogs bsten nas bka' gdams gzhung drug /bde mchog snyan brgyud sogs gdams pa ci rigs gsan/ de nas sa skyar phebs te sa chen kun dga' snying po'i drung nas lam 'bras chos skor rnams rdzogs par gsan/ dge bshes dkon mchog mkhar las mtshan nyid kyi gzhung dang*/ gzhan yang dbus gtsang gi mkhan chen bcu gsum tsam gyi zhabs la gtugs te zab mo'i gdams pa ci rigs gsan par mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum la chos rje sgam po pa bsod nams rin chen mjal nas phyag chen dang chos drug gi gtsos bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i gdams zab yongs rdzogs bum pa gang byos gsan par mdzad nas/ der bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i thugs dam gyi rtsal rdzogs te chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon du gyur/

sgam por bzhugs skabs nyid dang*/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa/ sgom pa shwa ston gsum la khams pa mi gsum zhes bsad pa gso ba sogs rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan par grags/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu la dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du byon nas gdan sa chen po phag mo gru'i dgon pa phyag btab ste 'phrin las shin tu rgyas/ de nas mang mkhar thun khang du lo gnyis dang*/ bde gshegs phug tu lo bzhi/ 'jags spyil du lo lnga bcas sgom sgrub la rtse gcig tu brtson par mdzad do/ /rje de nyid la slob ma gdugs thogs pa lnga brgya dang*/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon/ stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal/ gling ras pad ma rdo rje/ spar phu pa blo gros seng ge /mi nyag sgom ring sogs khyad par 'phags pa'i bu chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs byon cing bka' brgyud che bzhi'i ya gyal dang*/ chung brgyad kyi yab mes nyid du gyur/ gzhan yang rgya che'i dad ldan gyi skye 'gro rnams la chos 'khor rgya chen bskor te/ mthar dgung lo drug cu re gcig lcags stag spyi lo ( 1170) la sku gshegs so/ /༈ phyag rgya chen po'i lam zab mthar thug dkar po cig thub zhang gi man ngag rtsom pa po zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po ni rab byung gnyis pa'i chu mo yos lo spyi lo (1123) la skyid shod tsha ba grur snam zhang gi gdung las yab rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ yum yag mo mang skyid gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ mtshan dar ma grags su gsol/ dgung lo drug par yab las yi ge'i sbyor klog dang skyabs sems kyi sdom pa legs par bslabs/ dgung lo dgu pa nas bco brgyad bar mdo sngags kyi zab chos mang du gsan bzhes gnang*/ dgung lo nyer drug la khams su byon te mkhan po rgya ston mkhar mgo ba las bsnyen par rdzogs te mtshan brtson grus grags par gsol/ gtso bo grub chen dpal rgwa lo/ mal yer pa ba/ dngul chu bai ro pa/

sgom tshul te yin nges kyi bla ma bzhi dang*/ chos thob kyi bla ma so drug rnams bsten nas smin grol mthar phyin/ de las dwags sgom tshul khrims snying po las thabs grol gyi gdams pa gsan nas nyams bzhes mdzad pas bka' brgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs te/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa klong du gyur te sems kyi ngo bo rjen car du gzigs nas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs la sgro 'dogs chod/ rgyal khrims med pa'i bod khams 'bangs sil bur yod dus ri rgya klung rgya mdzad/ rgya 'og tu ma 'dus pa rnams sprul pa'i dmag gis btul te/ drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad pas dpon dar ma gzhon nu sogs slob ma mang pos 'khrugs gral du lha yi zhal mthong ba dang phyag chen gyi rtogs pa skyes pa du ma byung*/ de la log rtog can gyi skye bo tha mal pa mang pos skur 'debs kyi sdig bsags shing mi snyan par 'dug par chos rje dus gsum mkhyen pas bshol bas de phyin 'khrugs pa'i mtshams bzhag /rje sgom tshul gyis lung bstan te me lug la tshal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang rten brten pa dang*/ tshal yang dgon/ sku 'bum chen mo bcas gsar 'debs mdzad/ khong ni sku rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa du ma ston pa dang*/ tshal pa bka' brgyud kyi srol thog mar gtod pa bcas mdzad 'phrin bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'o/ /mthar rab byung gsum pa'i chu glang spyi lo ( 1193) dgung lo bdun cu don gnyis la sku mya ngan las 'das/ khong la bu slob grags che ba ni nam mkha' 'od/ kha rag pa 'dul ba 'od/ lha phyug pa nyi zla 'od/ 'bri rwa ba shākya 'od sogs byon no/ /༈ dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rtsom pa po 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po ni mdo khams ldan stod btsung grong zhes pa'i yul du yab skyu ra rdo rje dang*/ yum btsun ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung gnyis pa'i chu phag spyi lo ( 1143) lo sku 'khrungs/

dgung lo drug par yab las yi ge'i sbyor klog dang 'jigs byed dbang sogs zhus/ dgung lo bdun par rwa sgreng sgom chen dang slob dpon skyes bu gnyis las bstan rim dang*/ lho rdo rje snying po las gsang 'dus 'phags skor gsan/ dgung lo nyi shu la slob dpon ye shes las rje btsun sgrol ma'i dbang dang man ngag rnams gsan te nyer gnyis pa la sgrub pa nyams bzhes mdzad/ dgung lo nyer lnga par dbus su phebs te dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la gtugs te byang chub sems sdom gnang ste mtshan rin chen dpal du gsol/ de nas phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag sogs zab chos thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan par mdzad de nyer dgur g.ye chung du lo gsum la sgrub pa nyams len gnang*/ dgung lo so lnga la mkhan po zhang sum pa dang*/ slob dpon rtsi lung pa/ gnyal ba 'dul 'dzin sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs shing 'dul ba gsan/ de nas phag gru'i gdan sa lo gsum bskyangs te 'chad nyan spel/ dgung lo so bdun pa rab byung gsum pa'i sa phag spyi lo ( 1179) la 'bri thel byang chub gling phyag btab cing dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa bskyangs te 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srol gtod par mdzad/ gzhan yang dbus gtsang gi gnas chen mang por 'grims nas sgrub pa nyams bzhes gnang ste byin gyis brlabs/ dgung lo nga drug par phag grur gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa gsar bzhengs dang rnying pa nyams gso gnang*/ dgung lo drug cu re drug par spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas phag gru'i gdan sar bsko bzhag mdzad/ dgung lo don gsum par 'bri gung du dge 'dun khri tsho bco brgyad 'dus te chos rje phun tshogs rgya mtsho sogs kyi gtsos slob ma mang po gangs dkar ti se dang*/ gu ge /gu ya sgang*/ mang yul/ spu rangs/ la phyi/ tsa ri sogs su mngags te 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad do/ /mthar dgung lo don lnga par rab byung bzhi pa'i me glang spyi lo

( 1217) la dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs/ slob ma grags che ba ni spyan snga shes rab 'byung gnas/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas sogs spyan snga brgyad/ gnyos rgyal ba lha nang pa sogs thugs sras brgyad/ dpal chen chos ye sogs dpal chen brgyad/ ngor rje sogs ras pa brgyad/ gu ya gangs pa sogs gangs pa gsum/ khro phu lo tsā ba sogs lo tsā brgyad/ thag ma 'dul 'dzin sogs 'dul 'dzin bcu/ nyi ma seng ge sogs zhig po lnga bcas byon no/ /༈ chos rje stag lung thang pa'i zhal gdams tshogs chos rtsom pa po stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal ni g.yar shod bong ra steng du rab byung gnyis pa'i chu khyi spyi lo ( 1142) la yab ba na blon 'bar po dang*/ yum brab shi bza' dge sum khro mo gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bco brgyad par mkhan po bla sgang pa shes rab rdo rje las rab tu byung*/ dge bshes brag dgon pa las sher phyin 'grel chung dang*/ spyod 'jug /bslab btus/ lam sgron/ do ha sogs gsan te mkhas par gyur/ dgung lo nyer bzhi par dpal phag mo gru pa dang mjal/ dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung nas sras kyi thu bor dbang bskur te gdams ngag yongs rdzogs gnang bas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ chos rje'i nye gnas su lo drug bzhugs te zhabs tog ci nus bsgrubs/ de nas mal gror byon te slob dpon 'chad kha ba las bka' gdams dang*/ zhang sha ra ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/ dgung lo so dgu par dar sbas rong gsum dang phod mdo bas gdan zhus ltar stag lung du byon te/ rab byung gsum pa'i lcags byi spyi lo ( 1180) la phag gru'i lung bstan bzhin dge bshes po to ba'i bzhugs gnas kyi shul du stag lung dgon rten dang brten par gsar 'debs mdzad/ de nas bzung ste dpal stag lung pa'am chos brgyud 'dzin pa rnams la stag lung bka' brgyud par grags/ khong gi slob ma rab tu byung tshun chad khyim pa'i khang par mi 'byon zhing*/

sha chang mi gsol ba/ ska rags mi bshigs pa/ gling gseb tu bud med mi gtong ba sogs 'dul ba'i phyag len tshul bzhin gnang bar mdzad/ grwa pa sum stong lhag gi tshogs pa bskyangs nas gdan sar lo ngo sum cur bzhugs/ rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags rta spyi lo ( 1210) la sku gshegs so/ /khong gi slob ma'i gtso bo ni dbon rin chen mgon po sogs du ma byon/ gsung 'bum yang pod kha shas bzhugs/ ༈ dge sbyor bdun pa'i smon lam rtsom pa po 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras ye shes rdo rje ni/ yul myang stod khu ler rab byung gsum pa'i lcags sbrul spyi lo ( 1161) la yab rgya zur po tshab pe dang*/ yum mar bza' dar skyid gnyis la sras bdun yod pa'i chung shos yin/ yab kyis shin tu gces pas bon por bcol bas mtshan g.yung drung dpal du btags/ dgung lo brgyad par yum gshegs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis bar du gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos mang du gsan par mdzad/ de nas grub chen gling ras pa dngamajal nas zab chos mang po gsan zhing lo lnga'i ring bzhugs nas gdams ngag thams cad tshang bar thob/ dgung lo nyer brgyad nas mkhar chur byon te lcags phur can du 'dag sbyar lo gsum bzhugs pas/ snying rlung dang 'dre dmag sogs phyi nang gi bar chad ci byung yang 'chi nus thog 'gel gyis nyams su blangs pas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ mtshur phur rin po che dbu se las thabs lam gyi gnad du ma gsan te thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ 'bri gung pa las chos gsan te tsa rir byon nas klong rdol btab/ gung thangabla ma zhang dang mjal nas zab chos gsan cing snying rje la bogs thon/ dgung lo so gsum pa la mkhan po bzad pas rab byung dang 'gro mgon zhang las bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar 'brug tu dgon pa phyag btab/ de nas bzung 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi chos brgyud chol gsum bod kyi sa gnas gang sar khyab brdal du gyur te/

mi phyed 'brug pa/ 'brug phyed sprang po/ sprang phyed grub thob ces pa'i gtam zlum gzugs go la'i khyon du rlung ltar grags so/ /mthar dgung lo nga gcig pa rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags lug spyi lo ( 1211) la gzugs sku zhi dbyings su snyoms par zhugs so/ /rje de la slob ma dang po che ba spa rkyang gnyis/ bar du che ba rgya 'bras gnyis/ tha mar che ba lo rgod gnyis sogs mang du mchis so/ /༈ ro snyoms phyag rgya chen po sgang dril rtsom pa po rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje ni lho brag dol po lu chung du yab chu chal mon grags dang*/ yum zug mo dpal rgyan gnyis kyi sras su rab byung gsum pa'i sa bya spyi lo ( 1189) la sku 'khrungs/ mtshan mgon po dpal du btags/ slob dpon wa zhwa dang*/ zhang sogs slob dpon brgyad tsam bsten nas sher phyin dang*/ lam rim/ dbu ma/ spyod 'jug /phar phyin sogs gsan te lan re'i khong du chud par mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgu la ra lung du phebs te 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras dang mjal te rab tu byung bas mtshan mgon po rdo rje zhes btags/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung te dbang rgyud man ngag mtha' dag rdzogs par gsan par ma zad/ 'bri gung dang*/ rwa sgreng*/ tshal pa/ stag lung dgon pa rnams su phebs nas chos dang gdams pa mang du zhus/ de nas bla ma'i bka' ltar lho brag mkhar chu dang*/ gangs dkar ti se/ tsa ri/ dza lan+dha ra sogs sgrub gnas khyad 'phags can rnams su dka' ba drag tu spyad de sgrub pa lo mang mdzad/ la stod rgod tshang dang*/ steng 'bro/ gnya' nang/ bde chen steng*/ bar 'brog rdo rje gling rnams la dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad de don brgyud 'brug pa'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad de/ rab byung bzhi pa'i sa rta spyi lo ( 1258) dgung lo bdun cu pa la zhi bar gshegs so/ /khong gi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma rang las lhag pa ni grub thob u rgyan pa/

rang dang mnyam pa'i bu chen brgyad ni dpal ldan yang dgon pa/ ne rings pa/ ba ri ba/ phu ri ba/ ma bdun pa/ mod bo che ba/ gangs pa/ spyi dkar ba'o/ /de las gzhan byang chub gling sogs mkhas shing grub pa thob pa'i slob ma mang du byon no/ /khong ga ི gsung 'bum rnam thar dang*/ gdams mgur/ chab shog /sgrub thabs/ khrid yig gi skor sogs po ti bzhi bzhugs so/ /༈ chos brgyad rang grol lam mgo snyoms kyi gdams pa rtsom pa po 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ni/ rab byung lnga pa'i lcags khyi spyi lo ( 1310) la yab kun dga' 'bum dang*/ yum bsod nams 'bum gnyis kyi sras su shangs kyi chab lung du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun pa la 'bri klog bslabs/ dgung lo brgyad par a khus sa skyar khrid nas paṇa chen 'jigs med grags pa'i drung du mdo sngags rig gnas kun la gsan sbyong mdzad du bcug /gzhon nu'i dus chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsol ja ba mdzad/ de'i mod la skyo shas dang nges 'byung drag po skyes te sgro mon pa la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams la gdams khrid gsan te thugs su bstar bas nyams rtogs ji lta ba bzhin thugs su 'khrungs/ phyis zur phug pa dang*/ shugs gseb ri pa sogs las gdams pa zab dgu gsan nas brtson 'grus drag pos bsgoms pas rtogs pa mchog tu gyur/ 'ba' ra dgon pa gsar 'debs mdzad de tshogs pa bskyangs/ de nas spa gro la byon nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pas 'phrin las shin tu rgyas/ slar shangs su phebs te 'gro don yun ring mdzad/ de nas yang spa gror byon nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor te gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa bde legs kyis 'grub cing*/ rab byung bdun pa'i lcags lug spyi lo

( 1391) la dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis par dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim mo/ / zhes pa ni gyi na ba thub bstan 'od zer gyis dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas/ rtsom pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/rtsom pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ - PAGE 10 -- PAGE 7 -- PAGE 1 -
